svg.title: How IBM counts watsonx.data
svg.desc: How IBM counts watsonx.data, in three columns: SaaS in resource units, metered per second with a one-minute minimum; pay per use or a monthly subscription; software you run yourself, on premises or in your own cloud, priced by entitlement.
